newsitem.title: USA: WESTERN TO BUY INSURANCE COMPANY FOR $40.3 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: WESTERN TO BUY INSURANCE COMPANY FOR $40.3 MILLION.

text.p: The Western Systems Corp said Thursday it has agreed to buy the assets of privately-held American Country Insurance Co of Chicago and an affiliated company, for $40,250,000.

The company said financing for the purchase will be provided by the sale of about 24 million new shares of Western stock to three investors -- two private individuals and one publicly-held corporation, which Western did not identify. The stock sale would yield $27 million, the company said.
The balance of the purchase price, said Western, would come from $9 million cash on hand, and bank borrowings.
The company said that the deal, subject to regulatory and shareholder approval, is expected to close in July. Thursday, 1 May 1997 19:39:05 ENDS nN01214755
